crossRefs.note: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose…
because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

translations.web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
translations.bsb: because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
translations.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
translations.asv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:
